<details>
<summary>AI feedback</summary>

Reviewed at fce8fa0. The build passes. Returning 0 for null in *get the popover stack position* gives the same results as explicit null checks in *topmost clicked popover*, since every showing auto or hint popover has a position of at least 1. *hide popovers until* already accepts null, so a null `ancestor` in *light dismiss open popovers* is fine.

I pushed [a fixup](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/13303/commits/a5066a8aa15e5377c64547117d0a1e4c6794131c) that:

- Fixes #13298 by ending *nearest inclusive target popover* with "Return null.", so `targetPopover` can actually be null as the commit message says.
- Has that algorithm walk to the flat tree parent rather than "ancestor", matching *nearest inclusive open popover*.
- Replaces the undefined `element` variable with `node` in the form owner steps of *target popover*.

Please also add "Fixes #13298" to the PR description, which is used as the commit message.

</details>

@josepharhar, could you review the fixup?
